notes.title: Competition Time!
notes.content:
[h1] Win Early Access and be in the game![/h1]

I would love to get some [b]Community Input for ARENA[/b] and I think it would be fantastic to have the players design the Ship Liveries which can be selected in game! 

Take a look at the screenshots below from the newly developed Dock section of the game where you can customise your ship and unlock new liveries as your progress through the game.

All you have to do is draw your design and send it to me via email at mike.bushell@mbsquared.co.uk and I shall pick the winning designs. The winner shall get their design put in the game, an Early Access copy of ARENA and their name in game as a Ship Constructor.

Now get your crayons out or load up Microsoft Paint and get drawing!

[url=https://nofile.io/f/qa2dfdtKVrU/Template.pdf]You can download a template here[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25666128/ab82636b656ad2401945c5d37d56e5cbcc0cb573.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25666128/7d6df574cd0b5ff94a946cc3c0ceb35ff7dcc94e.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25666128/90609b6429c5efa36b53dfecf847257d3b8650ad.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 0.6.2 Build Uploaded
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Mouse issue where cursor would disappear from screen under certain conditions
[*] Fixed Screen space elements such as target reticule in Exosphere and Fragment highlight in Fathom are now properly aligned under all resolutions and aspect ratios
[*] Fixed Map issue under keyboard and mouse control where another level could be clicked on once another was open. Causing disruption.
[*] Fixed ARENA League leaderboard issue where using the mouse to click on a player entry would not open the correct entry
[*] Fixed issue where setting could not be exited with gamepad B button or escape key
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Revert number fonts back to original design to maintain consistency
[*] Resized tutorial hints and better placed
[*] Minor changes to navigation helpers
[*] Star Challenges balanced on Komorokai and Degna (much to the delight of my Beta Testers I'm sure)
[/list]
